Capture that repository-structure answer and include it verbatim in your final assistant reply here as well (do not post that answer into any chat). open_ended.question: List the top-level entries (files and directories) at the root of the GitHub repo 'psf/requests' and indicate which are directories and which are files; for the directories, indicate which contain a Python package (i.e., contain an __init__.py file).
